issue.title: Preserve conversation recovery and bind Portal proof observations
issue.body:
Conversation submissions and projections need durable recovery and owner-bound responses across reloads, authentication changes, and delayed requests. This branch adds journal/reconciliation handling, session acknowledgement checks, projection freshness regressions, and browser scenarios. It also strengthens source/proof observations, fixes nested fixture custody, and validates ownership of the browser-test server on its exact port.

This is a draft engineering proposal. At head `b64fdad2`, the retained local required attempt was refused for Git metadata identity drift and canceled before test selection or execution. That attempt supplies no passing-test credit. Fresh exact-head required execution, hosted checks, and independent review remain necessary before merge. No installed-service, authenticated-provider, or release qualification is claimed.

issue.title: Submit complete coding tasks and prove authenticated Portal recovery
issue.body:
The Portal now submits complete coding task intent through the v2 command contract, journals the exact request before POST, restores all fields after reload, and rejects changed intent under a saved key. Accepted task cards read owner-scoped snapshots and display exact queue blockers. Historical saved requests remain available for exact retry.

The connected proof packet authenticates a real farmd browser session, checks unauthorized access and discovery after cache loss, and keeps credential-bearing diagnostics in private proof custody. Both forwarded and embedded Portal lanes use the same component worker and receipt subjects.

Validation on dbb57bee978bb870555029e18cd14ea5b87e2413: full local required suite passed, including 258 unit tests, 14 mocked browser tests, bundle checks, lint, security and documentation. Independent review accepted the current source and exact inventory (13 new tests, none removed).

Remaining blocker: earlier connected and packaged runs failed after Candidate preservation because cleanup requested authority after terminal release. Their failures are retained. The paired Runner/Git cleanup repair and fresh connected proof are required before merging. No live provider execution, completed scheduler, conversational head, Slack integration, installed release or authentic showcase is established by these component tests.

issue.title: Recover operator commands with exact browser request binding
issue.body:
Operators can now discover their durable command history after local cache loss and reconcile a lost submission response using the original command. History pages preserve selected subjects and refuse stale or conflicting reads.

Browser submission freezes the request bytes before POST, derives the Kernel-compatible BLAKE3 command ID and framed payload digest, and checks every response against that subject. Exact retries accept the original command's current phase, including settled results. The pre-POST journal stores a validated snapshot; serialization hooks, changed caller objects and inconsistent saved subjects cannot replace it. Reload restores saved account/model fields without automatically submitting, and authentication failures retain the journal for reconciliation.

Validation on 4cd0fc89fa44e6f8b1f4c475f63519d9a8ff454c: full local required passed with 245 distinct unit tests and 14 mocked browser tests, typed build, lint, security and docs. Both current [push](https://github.com/neverhuman/bullet-portal/actions/runs/34433938798) and [PR](https://github.com/neverhuman/bullet-portal/actions/runs/34433940212) runs passed all six required jobs. Literal Rust-generated vectors verify browser digest compatibility. Independent static review covered each source packet and the actual test identity delta; no unrelated test was removed or check suppressed.

These are component proofs. Task-shaped server allocation, native controls, independent completion, persistent installation and authenticated provider recordings remain open. Operating HOLD remains effective.

issue.title: Add atomic operator snapshots and durable session controls
issue.body:
Control Tower and Shift Brief consume one authenticated atomic operator snapshot. Navigation preserves selected subjects and ordinary refreshes; stale and unavailable data remain visible.

Operators can inspect and revoke durable sessions. Lost revocation acknowledgements retain credentials, with explicit local-forget recovery. Generated models validate responses, and component launchers provision bootstrap files privately.

Validation on f946cdc648c4ca5225a7b60eb9cbe12b31425343: complete local required passed, including 214 unit tests, 14 mocked browser tests, typed build, lint, security and docs. All six required jobs passed in both current GitHub runs (34430006326 and 34430000472). Source packets received independent static review; test inventories use observed identities.

Matching Kernel changes are merged in neverhuman/bullet-kernel#4. These component results do not establish connected installation, provider execution, native controls, independent integration or authenticated showcase recordings. Operating HOLD remains effective.
